slices.focus: Eric experiences lightheadedness and nausea during holiday-rush evening counts, eventually taking two personal days after realizing symptom tracking alone is insufficient; the operation holds together without him, providing evidence that the system can survive his absence.
slices.summary: A health scare (lightheadedness, nausea during counts) forces Eric to take personal days, where he discovers the operation holds without him, leading to a trigger-list approach for earlier intervention: skipped lunch, antacid dependence, and dizziness as automatic course-change signals.
